corrected_answer: For variant 73, implement a dependency-light, typed Python function `first_duplicate_id(request_ids)` over a single-pass iterable. Specify a tagged result (or an otherwise unambiguous sentinel) for normal exhaustion with no duplicate. State the accepted ID domain and equality/hash policy; do not silently coerce IDs, and let unhashable IDs or iterator exceptions propagate (or document and test an explicit alternative). Include deterministic tests for empty, singleton, all-unique, adjacent and separated repeats, competing repeats, triples, invalid IDs, a one-shot pull-counting generator, and exact early termination. State expected average O(n) time and O(u) retained memory for u distinct IDs, qualify adversarial-hash assumptions, and explain that an unbounded unique stream has no fixed memory bound. Do not log or expose raw request IDs in diagnostics.
